title: DGM:归档里的父代采样
note: 移植的是 DGM 的归档规则:父代权重 = sigmoid(10*(分数-0.5)) / (1+子代数),让搜索从"一个走运的祖先"上散开。一次调用可提交多个 child:HG_DGM_CHILDREN 默认 3(上游 --selfimprove_size 默认 2),受剩余预算和可用编辑限制。逐 child 抽父代并选择 target,顺序生成后批量提交;不根据子代测量分数拒绝或回滚,归档保留规则只控制未来父代池。SWE-bench 的 gold patch、private test patch 和官方测试日志仍不提供,因此缺少上游诊断的重要信号。

deviations.what: The diagnostic prompt carries no gold patch, no private test patch and no test log.
deviations.why: The platform excludes them on purpose (INTERFACE.md 2.3, 2.4): a method that can read the verifier can fit the verifier.

deviations.what: One invocation can submit multiple children via `editor.report_many`: each child samples a parent from the same archive history and chooses that parent's target, then children are generated sequentially and submitted as a batch. No rejection means no post-measurement score-based rejection or rollback to an earlier incumbent via `incumbent_round`.
deviations.why: Upstream DGM_outer.py:90-100 samples parents with replacement and :111-148 selects an entry per parent. The port uses child-specific sampling seeds; repeated parents and identical edits remain possible. Only changed, usable edits are submitted, subject to the remaining budget. `keep_all` (default) / `keep_better` governs future parent eligibility, not whether a measured child is rolled back; malformed history and unsafe, unmeasured or uncompiled parents are still filtered.

deviations.what: `HG_DGM_CHILDREN` has default 3, whereas upstream `--selfimprove_size` has default 2 (DGM_outer.py:224). This is an existing port configuration choice and a default batch-size deviation, not the upstream default.
deviations.why: methods/dgm/run.py reads the environment setting and caps the requested batch by the remaining budget; missing parents or unusable edits can further reduce submissions. This documentation repair leaves that setting and its default unchanged; its effect on outcomes is not established.

deviations.what: `noise_leeway` remains configurable via `HG_DGM_NOISE_LEEWAY`, with default 0.1 matching upstream `--eval_noise` (DGM_outer.py:238).
deviations.why: As in DGM_outer.py:174-188, it affects only `keep_better`: the archive score floor is the initial score minus the leeway. The default `HG_DGM_RETAIN=keep_all` bypasses this floor. Environment-based configuration is a platform adaptation; no task-set-specific recalibration or statistical guarantee is implemented.
